defs.meaning: 到达，抵达；被看见，被听到；达到（特定的水平或数量）（reach 的第三人称单数）

examples.en: The snake usually reaches a length of 100 cm.
An alarm sounds when the temperature reaches a predetermined level.
examples.zh: 温度一达到预设的度数，警报就会响起来。

examples.en: Performance is lowest between 3 a.m. and 5 a.m., and reaches a peak near midday.
examples.zh: 工作状态凌晨3点到5点最差，近中午时分达到最高点。

translations: 达成协议；取得一致意见，达成共识
力所不及；无法达到；超出…的能力之外
无法达到；超出…的能力之外

pastExamSents.en: At times in the summer near the Mars the temperature can reach 70 degrees.
pastExamSents.zh: 夏天，火星附近的温度有时可以达到70度。

pastExamSents.en: When you are bored, you allow your mind to relax to reach all possibilities.
pastExamSents.zh: 当你感到无聊的时候，你会让你的大脑放松，去接触所有的可能性。

pastExamSents.en: In fact, I hated it at that moment, but my father said to me, "You can always see a beautiful sky at the top of the mountain, but you can't see it before you reach the top."
pastExamSents.zh: 实际上，我在那一刻十分厌恶它，但父亲对我说：“在山顶上你总是能看到美丽的天空，但在到达山顶前你是看不到的。”

pastExamSents.en: More efforts will be made to improve roads in rural areas to make it easier for farm products to reach cities and industrial products to hit rural markets.
pastExamSents.zh: 加大农村道路整治力度，让农产品进城、工业品进农村市场变得更容易。

pastExamSents.en: The probe is planned to reach the Red Planet in May or June in 2021, China Daily reported.
pastExamSents.zh: 据《中国日报》报道，该探测器计划于2021年5月或6月抵达火星。

idiomatic.zh: 到达某个水平 / 阶段
做出决定 / 达成共识 / 得出结论
